normalization: Internet Archive OCR text layers as fetched, uncorrected (text/<slug>.ocr.txt); the scan under original/<identifier>/ is the witness. Where the text layer is noise over a script (cuneiform, Avestan), the scan is the only reading.
scope: Geldner's critical Avesta as far as open scans reach: the issue with the Prolegomena and the third volume, the Vendidad. Which parts of the Yasna and Yashts the first item holds is read from its scan; Geldner's volume II (Vispered and Khorda Avesta) was not found in an open scan in this pass: QUEUED. The Gathas, the hymns of Zarathustra, are Yasna 28–34, 43–51 and 53.

why_seated: The scripture of the Zoroastrian tradition, whose dualism, angelology and last judgment the Second Temple apocalypses on the same shelf inherit.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-23: "detour for an ea-corpora seating. lets see. whats available of mayan texts? and then i dont think we have much or any deuterocanonical second temple lit - all those apocalypses. and what about the ethiopian canon? and euclid. all in original language or as close to it as possible. what else?" — "and the Egyptian book of the dead" — "and what about the fragments of the book of balaam? i might be miswriting this. recent discovery. if theyre available anywhere." — "yes yes yes to all - what a meal."
